_comment: PC keyboard/mouse controls for ELDEN RING (base game), keyed by the exact key_name / button_flag_names strings that appear in the per-frame annotation stream. Grounded in the base Elden Ring default layout plus the observed input vocabulary of video_annotations_EldenRing/ (scene 0001 of 85882349-EldenRing-paotu-084748). This capture uses a 'modernised' custom layout that, like the Nightreign layout, splits jump / sprint / dodge onto separate keys. Several keys are context-overloaded (E interact, R use-item, LMB attack-vs-cast, the wheel switch) so the vision refine pass disambiguates the real event. Two honest caveats: camera lock-on has no fingerprint in scene 0001 (no middle mouse / side button), and two-handing is tentatively mapped to the low-frequency KEY_F.
KEY_W: Move Forward (on foot or on Torrent)
KEY_S: Move Back (on foot or on Torrent)
KEY_A: Move Left (on foot or on Torrent)
KEY_D: Move Right (on foot or on Torrent)
TAB: Sprint / Dash (hold; observed as a long auto-repeating hold across the map run)
RI_MOUSE_LEFT_BUTTON_DOWN: Attack (R1, right-hand armament); also casts a sorcery/incantation when a staff/seal is equipped, or fires a bow
LCONTROL: Modifier: Strong/Heavy Attack (Ctrl+LMB) and Two-Hand toggle (Ctrl+Wheel) -- not observed in scene 0001
RI_MOUSE_RIGHT_BUTTON_DOWN: Guard / Block (L1, left-hand armament); aim a bow / catalyst
KEY_Q: Skill / Ash of War (tap to cast, hold to charge)
KEY_E: Event Action / Interact (open chest or door, pick up item, rest at Site of Grace, talk to NPC, read message, examine, operate mechanism)
KEY_R: Use Item (currently selected quick item: HP flask / FP flask / throwable / grease / Wondrous Physick / summon bell)
KEY_F: Switch to Two Hands (toggle) -- low-confidence inference from the base layout
RI_MOUSE_WHEEL: Switch Armament (wheel cycles the equipped weapon); zooms the map when a menu is open
UP: Switch Sorcery / Incantation (cycle the equipped spell)
DOWN: Switch Item (cycle the active quick-item slot)
ESCAPE: Open / Close Game Menu (Equipment / Inventory / Status / Equip Spells)
